items.title: Local RAG memory system that AI can write directly to
items.raw_excerpt: For me and my family, it get really annoying having to reshare information each time you create a new LLM chat. Therefore, I decided to create local-memory-mcp, a local MCP that allows LLMs to read and write to a RAG. It also has built in systems that help keep the system efficient like a max chunk size and deprecation when information gets updated. I would love it if you all would try it out and let me know your thoughts. It's been a huge time and token saver for us. Thanks for the help and enjoy!

title_i18n.en: Local RAG memory system that AI can write directly to
title_i18n.zh: 本地RAG记忆系统，AI可直接写入
title_i18n.es: Sistema de memoria RAG local al que la IA puede escribir directamente.

excerpt_i18n.en: For me and my family, it get really annoying having to reshare information each time you create a new LLM chat. Therefore, I decided to create local-memory-mcp, a local MCP that allows LLMs to read and write to a RAG. It also has built in systems that help keep the system efficient like a max chunk size and deprecation when information gets updated. I would love it if you all would try it out and let me know your thoughts. It's been a huge time and token saver for us. Thanks for the help and enjoy!
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我和家人每次新建LLM对话时都得重新分享信息，这真的很烦人。因此，我决定创建local-memory-mcp，一个允许LLM读写RAG的本地MCP。
excerpt_i18n.es: Para mí y mi familia, resulta muy molesto tener que volver a compartir información cada vez que inicias un nuevo chat con un LLM. Por eso, decidí crear local-memory-mcp, un MCP local que permite a los LLMs leer y escribir en un RAG.
